kind: passive original-data-write settlement over successful already reserved readback; no persisted schema
binds: complete original plan/source/upload/immutable allowances via authority
exact original still-pending mutation and observation attempt IDs
existing digest of exact destination metadata/read request/raw data
independently qualified original-write attribution/nonapplication/settled uncertainty and complete evidence

outcomes.Applied: requires matching exact original chunk plus exclusive original-write attribution; exclude preexisting bytes/independent writers and qualify original allocation and stable custody through read
outcomes.NotApplied: requires original nonapplication proof excluding transient write followed by overwrite; matching preexisting or different bytes alone imply no outcome
outcomes.Uncertain: requires an actually settled authenticated successful exact read that cannot resolve the original write; lost/absent/malformed replies remain pending

effects: pure read-only admission; no IO, remote calls, serialization, automatic receipt, retry, refund, provider or dispatch permit
spending: existing journal sole owner; qualified integration explicitly records receipt. Uncertain clears only observation, retains original pending mutation and all consumption. No allowance replenishment or new budgets.
integration_qualification: authentication, fresh unique challenge, original allocation and exact source/destination custody, observation chronology, exclusive write attribution/nonapplication and retained complete evidence. Extra remote calls require separately accounted authority outside this operation.
recovery: pure views leave original journal bytes unchanged. Explicit existing-owner settlement survives local reopen without providers/reissues, refunds or reference changes.
